say:1:1430218501:1.text: Yes, I agree. Sal'thorin is no longer divided into different classes of people. All the Essail are equal!
say:1:1430218501:1.source_cn: 没错，从今过后，萨洛克兰不再存在仆从和贵族，大家都是平等的！
say:1:1430218501:1.male: Yes, I agree. Sal'thorin is no longer divided into different classes of people. All the Essail are equal!
say:1:1430218501:1.female: Yes, I agree. Sal'thorin is no longer divided into different classes of people. All the Essail are equal!

say:2:1430218502:1.text: If I get the chance, I would like to leave and see the surface world.
say:2:1430218502:1.source_cn: 如果可以，我要离开这里，到地上去看看。
say:2:1430218502:1.male: If I get the chance, I would like to leave and see the surface world.
say:2:1430218502:1.female: If I get the chance, I would like to leave and see the surface world.

say:3:1430218503:1.text: I want to see with my own eyes the world which I was told as a youngster was the end of existence.
say:3:1430218503:1.source_cn: 我要去亲眼看看，那个被描述成末日的地上世界。
say:3:1430218503:1.male: I want to see with my own eyes the world which I was told as a youngster was the end of existence.
say:3:1430218503:1.female: I want to see with my own eyes the world which I was told as a youngster was the end of existence.
